3110928.findings: Six pieces of yellow-green vaseline (uranium) glass: four miniature covered dishes (hen on nest, turkey, cat on basket, dog on basket) with lace-edge bases, and two vaseline glass eye baths, one with a white opalescent rim. 3111030.findings: Large Royal Worcester bone china 'Bacchanal' dinner and tea service, grape vine border with gilt rims, spiral fluted. Shown: large oval platter, about 12+ dinner plates, side and bread plates, many cups and saucers, coffee cans and saucers, gravy boat on stand, covered sugar, milk jug, open vegetable/serving bowls. Estimated 80+ pieces. Backstamp read: crowned Royal Worcester circle mark with '51' (1751 factory mark, not a date), 'Bone China', 'Royal Worcester Made in England', 'Bacchanal'. Maker supported.
3111030.condition: Sold as is; no obvious chips visible at this resolution but not every piece can be checked; gilt rims appear reasonably bright.
3111030.reason: Extensive genuine Royal Worcester Bacchanal service, replacement-market value per piece could exceed $250 total.
3111030.marks_read: Royal Worcester crown/51 mark, Bone China, Made in England, Bacchanal

3111038.findings: Several stock books and an old schoolboy album. Stock books hold People's Republic of China J and T series stamps of the late 1970s-1980s: Pere David deer, panda with child, cranes, portraits, and grey-green mountain and pine landscapes that look like the T.44 Huangshan (1979) or similar landscape set, plus building issues. Old album pages: Australia Commonwealth (KGV heads, some modern) and Australian States pages for NSW, Queensland, Victoria, WA, SA with used QV-era states stamps, swan issue visible. A small box with bundled stamps. Values of individual stamps not readable.
3111038.condition: Album pages aged, stamps used and some toned; Chinese stamps appear clean, mint or CTO uncertain.
3111038.reason: PRC 1979-80s sets (possible Huangshan T.44) have strong collector demand; worth checking which sets and whether mint.
3111038.marks_read: Australia Commonwealth, Australian States NSW/Qld/Vic/WA pages; PRC J/T issues
